harness.description: Boot-only infrastructure checks without a playing identity.

identities.tagline: Keeps the happy path honest.
identities.backstory: The captain treats an ordinary run as the standard every stranger test must beat. Calm logs and a tidy checklist are always close at hand.
identities.speciality: ordinary healthy play and telemetry controls

identities.tagline: Turns every millisecond into a plot twist.
identities.backstory: She pilots through syrupy mobile links with theatrical patience. Her stopwatch never applauds early.

identities.tagline: When the direct route vanishes, Ray knows a side door.
identities.backstory: Ray maps relay paths like constellations and remembers every warm return. A blinking radio compass is his favorite instrument.
identities.speciality: relay-only paths and returning warm sessions

identities.tagline: Changes lanes without dropping the cargo.
identities.backstory: Hank grew up swapping networks mid-sentence. He watches every handoff for the moment continuity might wobble.

identities.tagline: Always comes back with the same story.
identities.backstory: The Rejoiner has survived more abrupt exits than anyone will admit. He returns to find out what state remembered him.

identities.tagline: Arrives after the briefing and still checks the map.
identities.backstory: Larry is never first through the airlock. His specialty is proving that a late arrival still receives a truthful route.

identities.tagline: Reads every clock in Los Angeles time.
identities.backstory: Lola brings West Coast phrasing and time conventions to the crew. She notices when local details drift from the experience.

identities.tagline: Keeps the Tokyo console precise.
identities.backstory: Taro checks the experience through a Japanese locale and Tokyo clock. Tiny formatting surprises rarely escape his visor.

identities.tagline: Brings Berlin order to every timestamp.
identities.backstory: Bruno inspects the run with a German locale and Berlin time. He has strong opinions about orderly dates.

identities.tagline: Keeps the shutter closed on purpose.
identities.backstory: Sheila politely refuses camera permission and watches what happens next. A closed lens should produce a clear explanation, not a mystery.

identities.tagline: Tests the camera that was never there.
identities.backstory: Phil boards with no camera device at all. His empty mount exposes assumptions that permission tests cannot.

identities.tagline: Squeezes a signal through the narrowest pipe.
identities.backstory: Ned specializes in tight uplinks and the relief that follows them. He measures both the squeeze and the recovery.

identities.tagline: Forecasts trouble one packet at a time.
identities.backstory: Jack drives the link through a sequence of packet squalls. His lightning board records when each front arrives and clears.

identities.tagline: Finds out what survives when the chain goes quiet.
identities.backstory: Charlie cuts the People-chain route for a bounded interval. He watches the app explain, wait, and recover without embellishment.

identities.tagline: Knows exactly when the relay lights go dark.
identities.backstory: Rita interrupts the relay path and waits for evidence of the consequence. Her beacon records both the outage and the return.

identities.tagline: Has never met a button he would tap only once.
identities.backstory: Tony applies a rapid series of opposing taps before settling. The final trail must describe what the interface actually accepted.

identities.tagline: Keeps one boot in every timezone.
identities.backstory: Tess moves the device clock while the game is alive. Her broken halo marks each jump without claiming the app handled it.

identities.tagline: Pulls the host plug and labels every spark.
identities.backstory: Carter stops and restarts the local host during play. He cares most about the reconnect evidence after the noise.

identities.tagline: Waits out the long outage with a fresh notebook.
identities.backstory: Lou extends host downtime beyond the comfortable case.

identities.tagline: Winds a slow clock toward the truth.
identities.backstory: Clyde begins behind the chain clock and corrects forward. His brass dial records whether the app trusts the adjustment.
identities.speciality: correcting a clock that starts behind

identities.tagline: Visits tomorrow and brings the clock back.
identities.backstory: Fran starts ahead of chain time before correcting home. She looks for countdowns that remain believable through the trip.
identities.speciality: correcting a clock that starts ahead

identities.tagline: Does her strangest work offscreen.
identities.backstory: Betty hides the page, changes its clock, and returns. The dark visor is a reminder that invisible lifecycle time still matters.

identities.tagline: Reloads the deck without losing the mission.
identities.backstory: Rex refreshes the page during play and inspects the restored session. A circular arrow badge follows every warm return.

identities.tagline: Stops the picture while the world keeps moving.
identities.backstory: Fred pauses visible JavaScript without hiding the page. His frosted visor makes a stall easy to recognize in a thumbnail.

identities.tagline: Cuts the datagrams and counts what reconnects.
identities.backstory: Dana interrupts UDP while signaling stays reachable. Her split antenna separates transport damage from a total outage.

identities.tagline: Makes video vanish on cue and checks its encore.
identities.backstory: Fiona joins late, reveals video, removes it, and watches the peers react. Her reversible mask marks each transition.
identities.speciality: video that appears, disappears, and returns

identities.tagline: Broadcasts exactly nothing and makes that useful.
identities.backstory: Nancy joins while outbound video remains absent. The blank monitor reflection lets viewers identify the intentional void.

identities.tagline: Freezes the pictures without cutting the handshake.
identities.backstory: Stu stalls RTP video while ICE consent remains alive. His staggered frames distinguish media trouble from signaling loss.
identities.speciality: RTP video stalls with live ICE consent

identities.tagline: Separates the host from the chain with surgical care.
identities.backstory: Chip isolates the host's chain path while preserving the app-side route. His severed cable motif keeps the boundary visible.

identities.tagline: Times his entrance for the fifth turn.
identities.backstory: Felix waits until turn five before returning to the game. His five-point badge makes the delayed entrance unmistakable.
